ko: 내 작은 지혜로 세상 그 누구도
나의 모든 길 주의 손에 있으니

en: (Korean worship song)
My one desire, I sing your love forever
With The beauty of your work in us
I will sing a song of (the) love

ko: 나의 왕 되신 주님의 얼굴 구하며
주 사랑 안에 머물러 사랑노래 합니다
en: My king, my strength
With the hope to see your face
Leaning on your loving mighty hands
I will sing of song of (the) love
Lord, I want to live my life to please You
I bring my heart before You to remold
Make of me a vessel fit for honor
That I might shine for You as sparkling gold
To be pleasing You, pleasing You
This is all I really want to do
Lord, I lift my heart in full surrender
All that I hold dear I give to You
Purify my heart and make me holy
That I might walk the way that's pleasing You
To be pleasing You, pleasing You
This is all I really want to do

ko: 나의 죄를 씻기는 예수의 피 밖에 없네
다시 성케 하기도 예수의 피 밖에 없네
en: What can wash away my sin
Nothing but the blood of Jesus
What can make me whole again
Nothing but the blood of Jesus

ko: 예수의 흘린 피 날 희게 하오니
귀하고 귀하다 예수의 피 밖에 없네
en: O precious is the flow
That make me white as snow
No other fount I know,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus

ko: 나를 정케 하기는 예수의 피 밖에 없네
사죄하는 증거도 예수의 피 밖에 없네
en: For my cleansing this I see
Nothing but the blood of Jesus
For my pardon this my plea
Nothing but the blood of Jesus

en: Nothing can for sin atone

en: Glory! Glory! thus I sing
Nothing but the blood of Jesus
All my praise for this I bring
Nothing but the blood of Jesus

ko: 믿음 따라 걸음 마다 말씀 따라
en: I walk by faith each step by faith
to live by faith I put my trust in you
( I walk by faith)

ko: 나의 가는 길 믿음 따라 갈 때
en: Every step I take is a prayer of faith
No weapon formed against me shall prosper

ko: 또 내 입술의 기도 믿음의 선포
주님 날 위하시면 누가 날 대적하리
en: And every prayer I make is a prayer of faith
And if my God is for me, then who can be against me?

ko: 믿음 따라 걸음 마다 말씀 따라
en: I walk by faith each step by faith
to live by faith I put my trust in you

ko: 크고 힘있고 능 있어 못할 일 전혀 없네
en: My God is so big
so strong and so mighty
There's nothing my God cannot do

ko: 저 산들도 주의 것 골짝도 주의 것
en: He made the trees He made the seas
He made the elephants, too

ko: 너로 인해 주님의 사랑이 싹 틔우고
